pattern.name: task_processing_loop
pattern.description: Standard pattern for processing a task from tasks.md

workflow.step: Read tasks.md and identify first incomplete task
Read design.md for relevant API contracts
If failed: analyze error, fix, re-verify
If passed: mark [x], write walkthrough.md if major milestone

pattern.name: verification_loop

flow.on_fail: Analyze error, fix code, re-run build
Analyze test failures, fix implementation, re-run tests

pattern.note: Repeat until all verification passes. Do not ask for user intervention.

pattern.name: milestone_documentation
pattern.description: Pattern for documenting completed milestones in walkthrough.md

structure.section: Brief description of what was completed
List of specific files created or modified
Any caveats, known issues, or follow-up items

pattern.trigger: Complete a major module or feature (not for trivial changes)

pattern.name: qa_handoff
pattern.description: Final handoff when all tasks are complete
pattern.output: 🛑 EXECUTION COMPLETE. All tasks in tasks.md are finished. Please switch Roo Code to Reviewer Mode and prompt me to begin the Kiro/Antigravity audit.
pattern.note: Do not add additional text or attempt to audit your own work

pattern.name: error_recovery

steps.step: Identify the root cause (not just symptoms)
If still failing, repeat from step 1

pattern.escape: Ask the user only if the error is clearly in design.md, not in your implementation

pattern.name: design_alignment_check

checks.check: Method signatures match, HTTP verbs correct

pattern.note: Do not proceed with verification until design alignment is confirmed
